name: Bastians Bar & Bakery
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bastian’s Bar & Bakery in Tirol**

Welcome to **Bastian’s Bar & Bakery**—your cozy spot in the heart of **Tirol**, where rustic charm meets modern flair. Whether you’re craving a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries, a perfectly brewed craft beer, or a slice of homemade **Apfelstrudel**, we’ve got you covered.

Sip on local **Tiroler** specialties like **Grüner Veltliner** or **Bier aus dem Fass**, paired with our freshly baked goods. From fluffy **Sachertorte** to savory **Käsekrainer**, every bite tells a story of **Tirol’s** rich culinary traditions.

Stop by for breakfast, lunch, or an evening drink—we’re open all week, and our terrace invites you to soak in the alpine vibes. Whether you’re exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in the **Ötztal**, or just passing through, **Bastian’s** is the perfect place to pause, relax, and recharge.

Come taste the warmth of **Tirol**—one delicious bite at a time. 🍽️🍺
